subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 4th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493.
source_quote: 4th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: drow guards count
fact: There are two drow guards in the chamber.
source_quote: The chamber has two Drow guards and one of the more elite Drow male fighters.

subject: elite drow fighter count
fact: There is one elite drow male fighter in the chamber.
source_quote: The chamber has two Drow guards and one of the more elite Drow male fighters.

subject: prisoners attacking from roof
fact: Six prisoners—Eldeth, Buppido, Shuushar, Jimjar, Topsy, and Turvy—attack from the roof with hand-held crossbows.
source_quote: Eldeth, Buppido, Shuushar, Jimjar, Topsy, and Turvy attack using hand-held crossbows.

subject: drow warriors present
fact: The Drow warriors are unable to react during the prisoner rush.
source_quote: The Drow warriors are unable to react.

subject: fight duration
fact: The fight took less than a minute.
source_quote: The fight took less than a minute.

subject: zurkhwood table
fact: The chamber contains a zurkhwood table.
source_quote: It contains a zurkhwood table and three chairs

subject: drow guard killed
fact: Ront kills one of the two drow guards.
source_quote: Ront, who prefers a straight-up fight, squeezes into the fight and strikes at the guard, killing him.

subject: drow guard hit by crossbows
fact: Eldeth and Topsy hit the remaining drow guard with hand-held crossbows.
source_quote: Eldeth and Topsy hit the remaining Drow guard.

subject: imbrosh hit by crossbows
fact: Imbros is struck three times by the fellow escapees' hand crossbows.
source_quote: The fellow escapees armed with hand crossbows fire at Imbros, who is struck three times.

subject: prisoner revolt sequence
fact: The prisoner revolt begins after Zalthir trips and the goblet shatters.
source_quote: Zalthir trips. Daz is startled and tries to help Zalthir, kicks the goblet that Zalthir tripped on. The goblet shatters. The guards turn towards Zalthir and Daz.

subject: prisoners in armory
fact: The rest of the prisoners, led by Buppido, rush into the armory.
source_quote: The rest of the prisoners, led by Buppido, take advantage of the distraction, rush into the chamber, and scramble into the armory.

subject: healing event
fact: Grygum heals Thorin with a moment’s incantation and a gentle touch.
source_quote: Grygum stands over the dwarf, and then, with a moment’s incantation and a gentle touch, bloodless flesh becomes rosy, gashes close, and broken bones knit instantly with a rush of magical healing.

subject: magic missile cast
fact: Daz casts three magic missiles at Imbros.
source_quote: It’s not one dart, but three darts.

subject: magic missile cast again
fact: Daz strikes with three more magic missiles at Imbros.
source_quote: Daz strikes with three more magic missiles.

subject: necrotic bell spell
fact: Grygum casts a necrotic bell spell on Imbros.
source_quote: Grygum points his finger at Imbros, and the dolorous sound of a bell fills the room.

subject: drow poison
fact: Imbros uses Drow Poison on Prince Derendil.
